C0791.title: Alert: Leaking Chipmakers' Core Supply Chain Data Abroad Constitutes a Crime Even for Minimal Profit
C0791.summary: In 2025, Tian, a senior procurement manager at a Shanghai semiconductor manufacturer, was commissioned by an overseas consulting firm and disclosed the company's 2022 silicon wafer supplier categories, suppliers, procurement ratios, and other core supply chain data, illegally earning RMB 3,685.92. The court convicted him of illegally providing trade secrets abroad, sentenced him to one year and nine months in prison, and imposed a RMB 50,000 fine.
